title: Women Are Sacred 2027:
headline: Someone who never heard of it learns in 30 seconds: this is the room where Native women's safety work comes together.
story: Women Are Sacred is NIWRC's national gathering, held every two years. Advocates, survivors, Tribal leaders and programs come together in one room. This teaser answers one question for a stranger: what is this?

Lead with the feeling of the room, not logistics. It is a text-and-music piece: fast words on the beat, then it slows down on the warmest faces, then the date. It must feel like a gathering of relatives, never like a warning about violence.
do: Open on frame 1 with the hook text over the fullest room shot.
One word per cut, on the beat, in the montage.
Slow down at 0:12. Let the warm shots breathe.
Build the end so the lockup drops in as a 2-minute job.
Crop out any “Specialty Institute” sign in Durham shots.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No old WAS lockup (two women holding hands), even in the background.
No images of harm or fear. No red handprint. No statistics.
Don't let it read as Durham. Durham is texture only.

bp_intro: There is no spoken audio, so no bite times. Output times are the teaser timeline. The Women Are Sacred archive is not in Drive yet, so archive shots say B-roll TBD on scrub. The frames shown are real Durham B-roll (Specialty Institute, July 2026), the allowed secondary texture. Use the archive first. The yellow box shows the 9:16 crop.

rows.frame_alt: Full ballroom of women at long tables, listening
rows.visual: The strongest wide of a full Women Are Sacred room: people gathered, energy. Archive: B-roll TBD on scrub. Fallback shown: Durham MVI_1084, a full ballroom. Crop centered on the front tables.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1, top third: Every two years, we gather. Cut on, no long animation. Stays up the whole 4 s. (True: NIWRC calls WAS its “biennial” conference.)
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.
rows.music: Music starts on frame 1. Native music only if it is created AND performed by a verified U.S.-based Native artist. Otherwise a neutral instrumental. Nothing “Native-inspired”.

rows.frame_alt: Woman with long gray hair at a table, speaking
rows.visual: A face. Archive first (TBD on scrub). Fallback: Durham MVI_1056, a woman at her table mid-sentence.
rows.motion: One word: <q>Advocates.</q> Same position every card.
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.

rows.frame_alt: Hands threading beads and corn on a string
rows.visual: Hands, not a face. Archive first. Fallback: Durham MVI_1153, hands beading corn. This card never sits on a face: we do not label a real person a survivor.
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.

rows.visual: A speaker mid-sentence at the front of the room. Archive: B-roll TBD on scrub. No old lockup on the podium or banner.
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.

rows.visual: A greeting: two people meeting, a hug, hands. Archive: B-roll TBD on scrub.
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.
rows.music: On the beat. Small lift into the slow part.

rows.frame_alt: Women at a table laughing together
rows.visual: Slow down. The two or three warmest shots you have: laughter, an embrace, a quiet moment between sessions. Archive first. Fallback: Durham MVI_1043, women laughing at their table. Hold each shot 2–3 s.
rows.motion: <q>This is Women Are Sacred.</q> Lands at 00:14, holds to 00:19.
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.
rows.music: Music opens up. Fewer hits, more space.

rows.frame_alt: Wide of the full ballroom from the back
rows.visual: Wide of the full room, or a Pechanga establishing shot once Nick confirms the footage is cleared. Fallback shown: Durham MVI_1084.
rows.motion: Text stack, big and clean: <q>October 5–7, 2027</q> / <q>Pechanga Resort · Temecula, California</q>. (NIWRC published these dates on 1 Oct.)
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.

rows.visual: Clean end frame. Hold the last shot softly darkened, or a plain background. Nothing else in frame.
rows.motion: was_lockup1.png only (the new WAS 2027 lockup). Never the old two-women lockup. White logo on a dark or red background reads best (NIWRC design rule).
rows.voice: No voice. Text and music only.
rows.music: Last note rings out. 1 s fade.
